Subject: VP/CTO alignment to unblock pilot — proposed next steps

Hi Ella —

Greatly appreciated the call earlier today. Quick recap and suggested next steps so we can keep momentum for the pilot: 

Recap (what we heard)
- Primary goal: reduce inference cost while keeping 99th-percentile latency under 250ms for short-form responses (~64 tokens).
- Current stack: mixed cloud GPU + burst CPU endpoints, planning a Q3 pilot focused on conversational search use case.
- Constraints: data residency within US, SOC2 compliance proofpoints, and predictable monthly spend for the initial cohort.

Qualification notes
- Pilot scope seems aligned with our Dedicated offering (reserved capacity + predictable throughput).
- Customer readiness: infra team is available but prefers one exec alignment call (VP / CTO) before we lock timelines.
- Procurement: finance is comfortable with a short pilot SOW once SD and execs align on success metrics.

Proposed next step — VP/CTO alignment call to unblock pilot
I recommend a 30-minute exec handshake followed immediately by a 30–45 minute technical deep dive with our infra / SE. Please pick one of these windows and I will send a calendar invite:
- Fri, May 29 — 10:00–11:00 PT (exec 10:00–10:30; tech 10:30–11:00)
- Tue, Jun 1 — 09:00–10:00 PT
- Wed, Jun 2 — 14:00–15:00 PT

Attachments: I attached a one-pager with pilot structure and our standard demo deck (redwood-demo-deck.pdf).

A few questions to make the exec call efficient:
- Who from your side do you want on the exec 30m? (VP Product, CTO?)
- Are there any non-negotiable compliance artifacts we should bring (auditor contact, SOC2 scope)?

If you confirm a time, we’ll include Ben Carter (infra SE) to lead the technical deep dive and Marissa Cole on contractual gates.

Thanks again — excited to move this forward.

Best,
Rishi Malhotra
